description.p: nailong is a lightweight Minecraft: Java Edition launcher written in Rust. Choose a Minecraft and NeoForge version, watch the install progress, and launch the game with an offline account. Incomplete downloads are detected and can be repaired.
It ships as a single native executable with no bundled runtime and keeps the launcher itself small.
Fabric, NeoForge, Forge and vanilla installs, with version pickers, progress and repair.
